close_source_full_text.claim_rule: Only verified full text may support a proposition that exceeds the abstract.

inaccessible_record_retrieval.claim_rule: A completed risk sample estimates residual risk and does not establish exhaustive coverage.

authenticated_interfaces.claim_rule: An access failure remains a coverage limit and cannot close the originality exception.

independent_assessment.claim_rule: Internal reproducibility work cannot establish independent reliability or field validity.
